name: Ozi Internal Link Booster — Smart Internal Linking for SEO
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.description:
Ozi Internal Link Booster helps you build a clean, effective internal linking structure without manual effort or risky automation.

Instead of blindly inserting links, the plugin gives you controlled keyword-to-page mapping, SEO-safe limits, and visibility into pages that lack internal links.

Everything runs locally on your WordPress site.
No external APIs. No tracking. No data collection.

Why internal linking matters:
Internal links help search engines understand content relationships, distribute ranking authority, and surface important pages faster.

Ozi Internal Link Booster makes this process simple, safe, and scalable.

How it improves your SEO:

  • Keyword → Page Mapping: Assign priority keywords to specific URLs.
  • Smart Auto-Linking (Optional): Insert internal links conservatively and safely.
  • Orphan Page Detection: Identify pages with zero incoming internal links.
  • Internal Link Insights: See which pages need stronger internal connections.
  • SEO-Safe Engine: Skips headings (H1–H6), existing links, and protected content areas.

Note: A Pro add-on is planned for advanced automation and reporting.
The Lite version remains fully usable on its own.

Features

  • Keyword-to-URL mapping for precise internal links
  • Conservative auto-linking (1 link per keyword per page)
  • Global limits to prevent over-optimization
  • Works with posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Internal link overview dashboard
  • Per-post internal linking insights inside the editor
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Ozi Link Booster → Dashboard
  4. Add keyword-to-page mappings
  5. Enable auto-linking if desired
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use external APIs?

No. All logic runs locally inside WordPress.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The Lite version is fully functional and free.

Is there a Pro version?

A Pro add-on is planned for advanced workflows.
The Lite version will remain stable and usable.

Will this over-optimize my content?

No. Strict limits and exclusions keep links natural and SEO-safe.

Can I use the dashboard without auto-linking?

Yes. You can use insights only and link manually.
